**Changelog for version 1.0.1:**

- Overhauled SKILL.md for improved clarity, modularity, and bilingual (EN/中文) documentation.
- Greatly simplified user interaction: user identity is now handled automatically by the system; users are never asked for open-id or personal details.
- Strengthened security and privacy: strict no-leak policy for user/internal identity, with all identity management performed in background.
- Reworked historical report retrieval mechanism: historical queries now always pull results live from the cloud API, disallowing local or memory-based report aggregation.
- Aligned all command usage and documentation to new unified internal-identity handling; usage examples updated.
- Minor file organization changes: some scripts restructured or removed (e.g. deletion of scripts/api_service.py).

- Initial release of child drowsiness and fatigue detection skill (version 1.0.0)
- Real-time analysis of children’s facial features from camera video to detect drowsiness (PERCLOS, head nods, eye glossiness)
- Computes a comprehensive fatigue index (0-100) and classifies fatigue levels
- Supports automatic reminders or voice prompts when fatigue exceeds threshold
- Strict open-id acquisition and privacy safeguards enforced before analysis or report queries
- Can display historical fatigue reports as Markdown tables with direct report links
